name: wink
description: Rust wgpu viewer with WASM and VuePress integration

scripts.dev: npm run build-wasm && npm --prefix docs run docs:dev
scripts.build: npm run build-wasm && npm --prefix docs run docs:build
scripts.rebuild: npm run build-wasm && npm --prefix docs run copy-wasm && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('docs/.vuepress/WASM_REBUILT.txt', new Date().toISOString())"

author: petrasvestartas
